note: Values are "<byte length> <sha256>" of the artifact text (EmitOptions::default()), "unsupported: <element kinds>" where the emitter refuses the program, or the recorded error or skip. The *_jope_emit values use the options `jope emit` writes Rust, Python and the manifest with (title "jope emit"); C++17 recipe and JavaScript are recorded under the default options only. C++20 is the same C++17 source compiled with -std=c++20. Fitted C++17 comes from fit_legacy_numeric_bound on toy_data(80 rows, 5 columns, seed 42) as in tests/golden.rs: the first 64 rows train, the last 16 are predicted. cpp17_recipe_ops and javascript_ops are the ops each emitter accepted at generation, probed one op at a time; every one is used by a program whose bytes from that emitter are recorded here. Recorded bytes never change. Two changes are additive and pass: fewer unsupported element kinds (the recorded refusal stays) and a newly accepted op. Bytes for a value recorded as unsupported fail until JOPE_COMPAT_FREEZE_REGENERATE=gained-support records them.
